summary: Iteration 6 backend testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py with 6 tests covering strict campaign_end enforcement: (a) no schedule_rows past campaign_end, (b) last date == campaign_end, (c) unique-date count = 45, (d) xlsx download has exactly 45 daily columns (2026-06-29..2026-08-12), (e) partial Week 7 header still exists, (f) blackout_dates never push spots past campaign_end. Regression: full-week 49-day campaign still yields 49 dates ending 2026-08-16. Also re-ran test_iteration4.py + test_iteration5.py — all 11 prior tests pass. Total 17/17 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is growing large; consider splitting allocate_spots_daily and build_output_workbook into a dedicated scheduling module for maintainability.
Date-column detection in the output workbook relies on isinstance(date) OR ISO string parse — behavior is consistent but a helper would DRY this across tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 introduced strict campaign_end enforcement in allocate_spots_daily(camp_end) and build_output_workbook n_days = (end-start).days+1. All strict-end + partial-week + full-week + blackout regressions verified. test_iteration6.py should be preserved as regression for future iterations that touch date generation.
